title: Pinterest’s AI now turns beauty Pins into action plans
key_facts: Pinterest showed Beauty Guides on Tuesday
Powered by Pinterest Intelligence (visual intelligence and generative AI)
Translates Pins into stylist terms like "balayage", "root melt" and "almond nails"
Tap "Get the Guide" for what to ask for, time, price range and maintenance
At launch covers hairstyle, color, nail shape and finish
quote_evidence: Pinterest on Tuesday showed off a new feature that will leverage AI to take action on your saved inspiration from beauty-related Pins, like hair and nail ideas, and turn them into actionable plans you can take with you to the salon.
At launch, the feature will work across Pins related to hairstyle, color, nail shape, and finish.
why_it_matters_hint: A practical AI feature for something people already do.
